page_title: NEW 1-2 ARS | Newcastle v Arsenal 28/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jarred Gillett saw the whole situation. That's a free kick to Newcastle.
90+6' 1 - 2 Gooal! Martin Odegaard takes over corner duties. Gabriel (Arsenal) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it low into the middle of the net. 1:2.
90+6' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) will deliver the corner kick.
90+5' Declan Rice (Arsenal) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
90+5' Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick.
90+4' It is time for a substitution. Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) is on for Joelinton.
90+4' Declan Rice (Arsenal) sends a long ball in, but Nick Pope comfortably gathers the ball.

90+3' Arsenal slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
88' Jarred Gillett shows a yellow card to Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) for his blatant foul.
88' Leandro Trossard will be replaced by Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal).
88' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Newcastle as the referee indicates there was no infringement!

86' Play continues despite the shouts by some Newcastle players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Jarred Gillett interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
86' That looked a certain handball by Gabriel (Arsenal) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!

84' 1 - 1 The ball hits the back of the net! Mikel Merino (Arsenal) meets a brilliant cross from Declan Rice and scores with a bullet header from close range. He puts the ball in off the bottom of the right post and Nick Pope had no chance of stopping that. The score is 1:1.
84' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes a short corner kick.
83' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) goes into the book and receives a yellow card. Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) behaves unsportingly.
82' The substitution is prepared. Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Martin Zubimendi.
82' Jarred Gillett interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jamaal Lascelles (Newcastle Utd). A free kick has been awarded to Arsenal.
77' Problems for Eddie Howe as Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Jamaal Lascelles replaces him.
74' The game is interrupted now, Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
72' William Saliba (Arsenal) commits a rough challenge and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul. Newcastle will take a free kick.
72' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the corner kick, but Nick Pope reads it well and stops the effort.

71' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the left side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance. The referee blows his whistle, Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.
71' The corner from Declan Rice (Arsenal) is hurriedly cleared.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mikel Merino (Arsenal) comes onto the pitch for Riccardo Calafiori.
70' Here is a change. Bukayo Saka is going off and Mikel Arteta gives the last tactical orders to Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal).

70' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
67' Substitution. Nick Woltemade makes his way off the pitch and William Osula (Newcastle Utd) comes on as his replacement.
67' A substitution has been made. Anthony Gordon is replaced by Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd).
66' Eddie Howe has decided to make a change. Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) replaces Jacob Murphy.
65' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Newcastle.

65' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball is out of play and Newcastle manage to earn a corner.
63' The ball possession is 38:62.
60' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
60' Arsenal take a short corner kick.

59' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the bottom left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Nick Pope, who pulls off a stunning save! Arsenal force their opponents to concede a corner.
59' Neat passing move from Arsenal in order to create new attacking opportunities.

57' Ooh that was close! Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
57' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) takes a short free kick.
56' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jarred Gillett had an easy-decision to make.

55' Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) receives the ball in space inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends his first-time shot over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
54' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
52' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
51' Arsenal are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
46' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Mikel Arteta probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Cristhian Mosquera. He is replaced by William Saliba (Arsenal).
46' The second half has just started.
45+8' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Poor challenge! Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is penalised for tripping and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle. Newcastle have a free kick.
45' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
45' Handball by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal). It's a free kick to Newcastle, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
43' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
42' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
40' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
40' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

39' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Jarred Gillett stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Newcastle are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
37' Arsenal take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

34' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) makes it 1:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Sandro Tonali and planted his close-range header into the bottom left corner. David Raya was helpless.
34' Newcastle work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
33' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.

32' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the right post. Nick Pope guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Arsenal.
31' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

30' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

29' Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) was in a good shooting position just outside the box and unleashed a first-time shot towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper made a decent save to thwart his effort.
28' Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.

26' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by David Raya, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
25' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) latches onto a pass inside the box, steps inside his marker and smacks a shot against the left post.

25' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the right post! What a huge opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
23' Corner kick. Arsenal will have an opportunity.
21' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
18' NO PENALTY! Referee Jarred Gillett has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Arsenal players are incensed.
15' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Arsenal, he's going to review using VAR.
14' Nick Pope (Newcastle Utd) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Arsenal.
14' A corner kick by Newcastle is thwarted by the well prepared David Raya (Arsenal).

13' Malick Thiaw (Newcastle Utd) makes a good late run into the box and times his jump perfectly to get on the end of the corner kick, but his close-range header is brilliant blocked to deny him a certain goal. Newcastle will take a corner kick.
13' The ball goes out for a corner. Newcastle can continue in their attacking effort.
13' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Newcastle get a corner.
13' The resulting corner from Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

11' Malick Thiaw (Newcastle Utd) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
11' Newcastle win a corner.
9' Arsenal are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
7' Half-chance! Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) plays a pass into the box, but Nick Pope reacts well to snuff out the attack.
7' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
6' Arsenal fail to score from a corner as Nick Pope (Newcastle Utd) leaps to collect the ball.

5' Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but the keeper dives and denies him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Arsenal.
5' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

2' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the resulting free kick. His header would have probably ended up in the middle of the goal, but Nick Pope pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
2' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle after Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Arsenal have been awarded a free kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Arsenal will have the kick-off.
Jarred Gillett will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
